tool_input.title: shop namespace: 5xx with all pods Running = Service selector drift
tool_input.content:
Incident: HighErrorRate alert on shop namespace (aurora-lab on-prem cluster, kind-aurora-lab / cluster_id kubeconfig-bf223c2bda6f7755). frontend pods returned 502 on /api/* while ALL pods reported Running/Ready.

Root cause: `api` Service's live `spec.selector` was `app: api-v2`, diverging from its own `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` annotation (`app: api`) — i.e. someone/something ran an out-of-band `kubectl patch/edit` on the Service that bypassed the manifest apply flow. Actual `api` Deployment pods carry label `app=api`, so zero pods matched the Service selector → `kubectl get ep api` showed `<none>` → kube-proxy had no backend to DNAT to → ClusterIP connections got "Connection refused" → nginx frontend returned 502 for every /api/ request.

**Why this is tricky:** "All pods Running" looks healthy and misleads toward blaming app code or resources. The actual break is at the Service/Endpoints routing layer, invisible unless you check `kubectl get svc,ep -n NAMESPACE` and compare Service selector vs pod labels.

**How to apply / diagnostic checklist for 5xx + all-pods-Running in this cluster:**
1. `kubectl get svc,ep -n <ns>` — look for any Service with empty ENDPOINTS despite Ready pods.
2. `kubectl get svc <name> -o yaml` — compare live `spec.selector` to the `last-applied-configuration` annotation; a mismatch indicates manual drift.
3. `kubectl get pods -n <ns> --show-labels` — confirm which label pods actually carry.
4. Check downstream caller's logs (e.g. nginx frontend) for `connect() failed (111: Connection refused)` to the ClusterIP — this confirms the symptom is live, not theoretical.
5. Fix: `kubectl patch svc <name> -n <ns> -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"<correct-label>"}}}'` to realign selector with actual pod labels (verify no intentional canary deployment exists first via `kubectl get deployments -o wide` and `kubectl get pods -l app=<new-label>` across all namespaces).
tool_input.description: HighErrorRate on shop/frontend /api/ with all pods Running was caused by api Service selector drifting to app:api-v2 (no matching pods), leaving zero Endpoints; not a pod/resource issue
